## Emerald 2.2.2-dev.2

This prerelease adds automatic, privilege-free Linux updates and retains the
AppImage compatibility fixes from `2.2.2-dev.1`.

### Automatic Linux updates

- **Check for Updates…** now offers **Install & Restart** on every Linux build,
  rather than leaving the verified AppImage in Downloads.
- When Emerald is already an AppImage, the updater replaces it in place. A
  native or development installation is upgraded to the self-contained
  AppImage at `~/.local/bin/emerald`.
- A detached installer waits for Emerald to close, stages the new executable
  beside its destination, retains a rollback copy until activation succeeds,
  and then reopens Emerald.
- Installation stays within user-owned locations and never requests `sudo`. A
  read-only AppImage location automatically falls back to
  `~/.local/bin/emerald`.
- Download size and SHA-256 verification still complete before any executable
  is replaced.

### One-time transition from dev.1

`2.2.2-dev.1` can update itself in place when it is already running as an
AppImage, but a native installation still uses the old download-only path. In
that case, install `dev.2` from Downloads once, or replace the current per-user
executable with:

```bash
install -m 755 ~/Downloads/Emerald-x86_64.AppImage ~/.local/bin/emerald
```

Updates initiated from `dev.2` and later install and restart automatically.

### Linux compatibility

- AppImages select their bundled XCB plugin when Wayland is unavailable and
  use Qt's reliable raster widget backing store by default, avoiding the
  Wayland-plugin and `QRhiGles2` errors fixed in `dev.1`.

### Testing notes

Please check for an update from this build when a newer development release is
available. Confirm that Emerald closes, replaces the executable, and reopens
without leaving the AppImage in Downloads or asking for administrator access.

### Downloads

| Platform | File | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Linux (x86-64) | `Emerald-x86_64.AppImage` | `chmod +x` and run |
| Linux (ARM64) | `Emerald-aarch64.AppImage` | requires glibc 2.39 or newer |
| macOS (universal) | `Emerald-macOS.dmg` | drag to Applications; first launch **right-click → Open → Open** |
| Windows | `Emerald-win64-setup.exe` | installer with Markdown **Open with** registration |
| Windows portable | `Emerald-win64.zip` | extract and run `emerald.exe` |
